claims.claim: Rayleigh scattering intensity is proportional to 1/wavelength^4, so 450 nm scatters (700/450)^4 = 5.9 times more than 700 nm and 550 nm 2.6 times more.
claims.note: ratios computed from the 1/lambda^4 law; wavelengths are representative values

claims.claim: Violet scatters more than blue, but the sky looks blue because sunlight contains less violet, some is absorbed high in the atmosphere, and human eyes are less sensitive to violet.
Relative air mass reaches approximately 38 at the horizon.
